newsitem.title: FRANCE: CLERGYMEN INVESTIGATED IN FRANCE PAEDOPHILIA PROBE.
newsitem.headline: CLERGYMEN INVESTIGATED IN FRANCE PAEDOPHILIA PROBE.

text.p: Two clergymen and eight teachers were among 181 suspects being investigated by French magistrates over child sex videos as the country's biggest ever crackdown on paedophiles widened on Wednesday.
Dozens more people were still in detention awaiting questioning, police said.
Gendarmes rounded up more than 600 people on Tuesday in raids to break up a network selling pornographic films including boys.
"Searches are continuing. We're up to 611 this morning," a police source said.

Those placed under investigation were suspected of "handling images from the crime of corruption of minors aged under 15". Being placed under investigation under French law is short of an indictment but is a first step towards a trial.
The raids followed 14 months of investigation which led the gendarmerie to a mail-order company in the central town of Macon selling pornographic films involving boys.

Tuesday's operation -- dubbed "Ado 71" after the French word for teenager and the car registration figure for the Macon region -- involved some 2,500 gendarmes in mainland France as well as the French Caribbean islands of Martinique and Guadeloupe.
Gendarmes seized 250 pornographic cassettes which the company had bought outside of France, mainly in Spain and Poland, and then copied.
